description: X-FILES exports `information.txt`, `system.txt`, or both. Distinctive fields include `Operation ID`, `Hardware ID`, `CPU (Processor)`, `GPU (Display Devices)`, and `Desktop screenshot taken`. Some public reporting describes DeerStealer as a rewritten or evolved XFiles line; this catalog keeps it out of the alias list pending stronger format-level equivalence.
name: XFiles
targets: Browser saved credentials and cookies (Chromium and Gecko)
